property_summary: If schedule(...) succeeds then the operation becomes recorded (isOperation true and timestamp increases), and if schedule(...) reverts then the operation presence and timestamp remain unchanged.
If schedule(...) succeeds then getTimestamp(id) > 0 and isOperationPending(id) is true when delay >= getMinDelay().
If schedule(...) is called by an address that has PROPOSER_ROLE and delay >= getMinDelay(), then after the call the operation's timestamp is > _DONE_TIMESTAMP (i.e., pending) and isOperation(true).
